title: StrictLocalCohomologySourceColimit
statement: For a scheme S, geometric point s, L in D⁺(Ab(S_et)) and n an integer, the cocone with the canonical source legs [def-weil-pbc-small-model-cohomology-germs] is colimiting. Its vertex is Γ(S_(s),H^n(g^*L)); its domain is the derived-sections presheaf restricted to small affine pointed neighbourhoods.

source.place: Tags 03Q9, 03Q8 and 0BKV; neighbourhood colimit and final injective-complex paragraph

proof.text:
initiality of the small affine pointed representatives makes the restricted
presheaf germ cocone colimiting. The derived-sections-to-homology-sheaf map induces
an isomorphism on stalks. Compose it with the strict-local germ restriction and the
exact-inverse-image homology isomorphism. Transport the germ cocone through this
composite isomorphism; its legs are exactly the displayed canonical source legs.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03Q9 and 0BKV, with canonical derived Hom comparisons expanded by G2
